summary: the same state id is declared more than once
help: Declare each state once, and give a composite body a single home.
rationale: A repeated declaration makes the labels and composite bodies ambiguous.

summary: the same transition is declared more than once
rationale: Repeated transitions render stacked arrows, which is usually copy-paste noise.

summary: composite state has an empty body
help: Add the child states, or declare it as a simple state.
rationale: An empty composite renders as a bare box that carries no information.

summary: a state has a transition to itself
help: Confirm the self-transition is intended, or point it at another state.
rationale: Self-transitions are valid and common in state machines, so this rule is off by default to avoid noise.

summary: The diagram header is not stateDiagram or stateDiagram-v2
rationale: Detection resolves the kind from the header, so this condition is already reported as common/unknown-diagram-kind.
reason: the kind comes from the header in the kinds table, so a missing or unknown header is common/unknown-diagram-kind

summary: A single arrow -> is used instead of -->
rationale: The state grammar only accepts the double arrow, so a single arrow does not connect the states.

summary: A concurrency separator --- is used inside a composite state
help: Use separate states or regions without '---'.
rationale: Mermaid state diagrams do not support the --- separator, so the line misparses or disappears.

summary: A state block state X { is not closed
rationale: Everything after the open brace is read as the block body, so the rest of the diagram misparses.

summary: Note statements are malformed or missing a colon.
help: Example: Note right of A: message
rationale: Without the colon the note text has no place to start.
